تعتطفون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَطِفُونَ (taʕtaṭifūna) /taʕ.ta.tˤi.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# تُعْتَطَفُونَ (tuʕtaṭafūna) /tuʕ.ta.tˤa.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
